subject: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@elara.com>, ops@elara.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool

Samir / Elara ops team,

Thanks again for the call earlier. Based on the discovery and target ramp (initial prod traffic expected 120 qps with spiky peaks to ~420 qps for 45–90m windows), we recommend a rapid-turnup approach: a 3-day burst sprint to provision a dedicated pool, validate autoscale rules, and run warmup priming for KV/prefix caches. The goal is to have a production-safe pool available for canary traffic by Tuesday EOD.

High-level proposal (this email captures the handoff items for ops / your SRE):
- Pool baseline: 4x A10G instances (min_keepalive 2) for steady state; burst to up to 12x A10G or 4x H100 equiv during scheduled spikes.
- Autoscale policy: target metric = rolling 1-min P95 token latency + queue depth. Scale up when avg queue_depth_per_instance > 0.8 for 60s, scale down after idle 10m.
- Burst strategy: scheduled burst windows with pre-warm step (KV cache population + prefix priming) 15–30 mins before expected peak. Unscheduled bursts fall back to regional pooling (see fallback below).
- Regional selection: primary us-west; fallback us-east for capacity and eu-west for compliance-critical reads.
- Warmup: run representative prompt set (subset attached) to prime KV caches; expect ~5–8 minutes of warmup for each H100 instance, ~3–5 minutes for A10G.

Action items I need from Elara today:
1) Confirm preferred device family for burst (A10G vs H100) and whether you accept temporary heterogenous pool mixing during bursts.
2) Confirm maintenance window constraints (we proposed 00:00–05:00 UTC for disruptive ops).
3) Provide a short list of 8 representative prompts for cache priming (we included a starter set in attachment).

I'll loop in Monica for the activation checklist and Ben for the autoscale rule tuning. I'll prepare a 3-day plan with checkpoints and rollback criteria once you confirm the device choice.

Regards,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: elara_activation_playbook_v1.pdf (8 pages), pool-topology-recommendation.xlsx (sheet: recommended-topologies)
From: Samir Rao <samir@elara.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@elara.com, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool

Thanks, Sergio — this looks good and aligned with our needs. A few clarifications: 

- Device family: we prefer A10G for cost now but want the option to temporarily shift to H100 for known high-load experiments. We accept heterogenous mixing during bursts as long as performance profiles are transparent.
- Maintenance window: avoid 01:00–03:00 PDT (we have a regional nightly batch). The 00:00–05:00 UTC window is fine otherwise.
- Prompt set: attaching 6 representative prompts now (see inline below). We'll add two more by EOD.

One more ask: can Redwood auto-populate KV cache from our snapshot during burst warmup or do you need live traffic to warm caches? If snapshot seeding is possible, it will significantly shorten warmup time.

Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Infrastructure, Elara Therapeutics

On 2026-09-28 09:12, Sergio Alvarez wrote:
> Samir / Elara ops team,
> 
> Thanks again for the call earlier. Based on the discovery and target ramp (initial prod traffic expected 120 qps ...)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@elara.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool

Samir — great questions. Short answers: 

- Cache seeding: yes, we can seed the prefix/KV caches from a customer-provided snapshot. We have a simple JSON-lines format ingestion that our activation runbooks support. Monica will coordinate the snapshot handoff and run the seed prior to scheduled bursts.
- Heterogenous pools: supported. We use model variant tagging and kernel-selection heuristics to route requests to the optimal device automatically. You will see per-device perf metrics in the console during the spike.
- Warmup validation: we'll run a quick synthetic smoke test after seed to verify latency p95 and token correctness.

Proposed 3-day sprint (high level):
Day 0 (today): confirm HW, hand off snapshot and prompt set, schedule burst windows.
Day 1: provision pool + basic smoke tests + seed KV caches.
Day 2: run staged canary traffic (10% traffic), tune autoscaler params mid-day.
Day 3: full canary -> go/no-go for production cutover.

Ben — can you prepare the initial autoscale rules that match Sergio's note and include a conservative max ramp rate? I recommend a cap of +30% per minute for scale-ups to avoid overshoot.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@elara.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool

Folks — draft autoscaler rules attached and summarized below. I kept them conservative for the first 48 hours.

Summary:
- Metric: effective_utilization = max(token_queue_depth / capacity, p95_token_latency_normalized)
- Scale up trigger: effective_utilization > 0.75 sustained for 60s.
- Scale down trigger: effective_utilization < 0.45 for 10m.
- Max ramp: +30% instances per 60s (configurable).
- Burst pre-warm: scheduled window initiates a 20-minute seed + 10-minute smoke test before traffic redirection.
- Safety: keep 2 instances in warm standby (min_keepalive). Canary routing uses 5% of traffic for initial validation.

Attachments: elara_autoscale_rules_v1.json (rules + sample telemetry thresholds)

I'll push these to the test environment tonight and sync metrics names with Elara's telemetry team. One quick ask for Elara: provide the metric path for queue_depth and a single sample trace where you saw the earlier spike so I can calibrate the normalization constant.

Ben
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@elara.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool

Thanks team — attaching the two remaining prompts and a sample trace of the peak incident from last month (trace-id: elara-peak-20260815). We are comfortable starting with A10G and switching to H100 for the expansion experiment later this quarter.

We accept the autoscale caps and pre-warm windows. Maintenance exception: please avoid any live topology changes between 2026-10-01T02:00:00Z and 2026-10-01T06:00:00Z — that's our compliance audit window.

Samir
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@elara.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, partner@cloudinfra.co
Date: 2026-09-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid turnup & burst sprint — Elara Therapeutics dedicated GPU pool

All — great, thanks for the fast turnaround. Confirmed next steps and checkpoints: 

1) Elara provides final prompt set + KV snapshot by 2026-09-29 23:59 PDT.
2) Redwood provisions baseline pool in us-west (4x A10G) and seeds cache during Day 1 provisioning.
3) Ben pushes autoscale rules to test env and we run a smoke test at 09:00 PDT on 2026-09-30.
4) Canary (5% traffic) scheduled for 2026-10-01 09:00 PDT; full cut (if metrics green) by 2026-10-01 14:00 PDT.

Rollback criteria (short): sustained P95 token latency > 1200ms post-canary, or error-rate > 3% for 15m. Monica will run the rollback steps; Ben will execute capacity shrink if required.

CloudInfra Consulting — we may call on you tomorrow for netops-level VLAN cross-connect verification. Can you confirm availability for a short 30m slot tomorrow 11:00–11:30 PDT?

I'll convert this thread into the activation checklist doc and share the Drive link once Ben uploads the autoscale rule file.

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: activation-checklist-link (Drive), elara_autoscale_rules_v1.json (attached by Ben)
